rows.notes: The document is a UF/IFAS Extension publication (AE354) that summarises prior work by the authors and others (Dukes et al. 2003; Munoz-Carpena et al. 2005; Smajstrla and Locascio 1996; Dukes and Scholberg 2005) on soil-moisture-sensor-based irrigation control. It reports no new data, experiment or survey of its own; Figures 1-2 show a controller prototype but all quantitative results (e.g., 70% savings on drip tomato, 50% on bell pepper, 11% for subsurface drip vs sprinkler) are attributed to cited studies. Nothing in the text states irrigation efficiencies of 80-90% for sprinkler with sensors versus 40-45% for surface irrigation; the claimed figures do not appear in the document at all.

notes: Extension fact sheet (originally 2005, revised 2024), not a primary study; the cited 80-90% vs 40-45% efficiency figures are absent from the text.
